desc: Read the input values for $N$ and the coordinates $(X_i, H_i)$.
Compute the convex hull of the set of points using the Monotone Chain algorithm.
Iterate through all edges of the convex hull. For each edge connecting $(X_1, H_1)$ and $(X_2, H_2)$, calculate the y-intercept $K = \frac{H_1 X_2 - H_2 X_1}{X_2 - X_1}$.
Track the maximum value of $K$ found.
If the maximum $K$ is negative, print -1. Otherwise, print the maximum $K$ with high precision.
Test the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.

Consider potential floating-point precision issues during cross-product calculations in the Monotone Chain algorithm (though with coordinates up to $10^9$, the cross product can reach $10^{18}$, which fits in a 64-bit integer, so integer arithmetic is safe for the hull construction).
Ensure the output format matches exactly (e.g., -1 vs -1.0).
Run the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Check edge cases (e.g., collinear points, $N=2$, large coordinates).
Ensure output format matches requirements (absolute/relative error).
